data.name: SkyLeague
data.detailed_description:
Car soccer, taken seriously

Sky League is a competitive car-soccer game built around precise, expressive

vehicle physics. Learn to turn every acceleration, landing, wall transition,

and aerial touch into an advantage.

Master your Skycar

Build speed on the ground, carry momentum through the walls, and take control

in the air. Develop advanced mechanics including flicks, dashes, air control,

flip resets, and pinches.

Compete in high-intensity matches

Play fast, team-focused soccer matches where positioning, mechanical execution,

and split-second decisions matter. Create opportunities for your teammates,

deny your opponents, and turn a single touch into a goal.

Make it yours

Choose your car body, wheels, paint, boost, and trail to create a distinctive

Skycar. The garage is part workshop, part identity: build a machine that looks

as deliberate as the way you play.

Enter Dark City

Compete beneath a nighttime skyline of neon towers, moving transit, and dense

urban light. Sky League combines high-speed sport with a mature cyberpunk

identity built for dramatic matches and memorable arenas.

Built to reward practice

The fundamentals are readable; mastery is not. Dedicated training experiences

help players develop ground control, aerial movement, ball control, and the

advanced mechanics needed for competitive play.

Sky League is in active development. Features and presentation may evolve

before release.
